name: Selene, The Stormcaller

selene_idle@loop.maps_to: alive, not moving, out of combat (no enemy near, no attack for 2 s; hub)
selene_idle@loop.purpose: relaxed breathing stance, the launcher low in the right hand, the left hand loose, weight drifting

selene_idle_combat@loop.maps_to: alive, not moving, in combat (enemies near or an attack in the last 2 s). Frame 0 is the reference pose of every upper-layer clip
selene_idle_combat@loop.purpose: the combat hold: bladed, the launcher at the right hip on the aim, the left hand on the foregrip, a light bounce on the knees

selene_walk@loop.maps_to: moving at under about 55 % of move speed (stick partly pushed, slows); playback rate = speed / 1.72 m/s
selene_walk@loop.purpose: a light, upright walk, hips swaying, the launcher carried low, the left arm swinging

selene_run@loop.maps_to: moving within 45 deg of the aim at move speed; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s
selene_run@loop.purpose: a long, light run leaning into the move, the launcher held at the hip on the aim with both hands

selene_strafe_left@loop.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the left of the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s
selene_strafe_left@loop.purpose: side run to her left, hips opened toward the travel, the chest and the launcher kept on the aim

selene_strafe_right@loop.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the right of the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s
selene_strafe_right@loop.purpose: side run to her right, the hips turned into the travel, the launcher kept on the aim

selene_backpedal@loop.maps_to: moving more than 135 deg away from the aim; playback rate = speed / 7.0 m/s
selene_backpedal@loop.purpose: backpedal on the balls of her feet, the launcher up on the aim

selene_dash.maps_to: the 0.16 s dash (MoverState.dash_left > 0); the client faces the hero along the dash for its duration
selene_dash.purpose: the dash burst: a low lunge-glide leaning into the move, the launcher tucked on the aim in the right hand (the left lets go of the foregrip for the lunge), the capes streaming

selene_dash_recover.maps_to: the first 0.45 s after a dash ends when the hero is not moving on (else blend into locomotion)
selene_dash_recover.purpose: landing out of the dash: the lead foot plants, a soft absorb, back into the hold

selene_fire_light.maps_to: each primary shot of a light chassis (fire_rate >= 2/s: the thundercoil_launcher fires 3.5/s)
selene_fire_light.purpose: one orb shot: a snap forward, the launcher kicks up and back, the body rides it (recoil stays procedural)

selene_fire_heavy.maps_to: a heavy / charged release (fire_rate < 1/s, charge release, splash chassis)
selene_fire_heavy.purpose: a charged shot: brace into the aim, release, the launcher bucks up and the body rocks back

selene_fire_charge@loop.maps_to: fire held on a Charge chassis (FireKind::Charge) until release (then fire_heavy)
selene_fire_charge@loop.purpose: holding a charge: braced low behind the launcher, trembling with the stored storm

selene_hit_light.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a light hit (damage < 10 % max HP), layered over whatever plays
selene_hit_light.purpose: a flinch: the head snaps, the launcher is knocked up, absorb, recover

selene_hit_heavy.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a heavy hit (damage >= 10 % max HP or a stun); interrupts upper-layer clips
selene_hit_heavy.purpose: a big stagger: blown back, the left hand torn off the foregrip, the lead foot steps back, absorb, step back in

selene_knockdown.maps_to: a knockback / launch strong enough to floor the hero (stun >= 0.8 s); holds its last frame until get_up
selene_knockdown.purpose: blown off her feet: impact, a backward fall, the bounce, lying on her back with the capes spread

selene_get_up.purpose: from her back: up on the left hand, roll onto one knee with the launcher gathered in, rise into the hold

selene_death.maps_to: LifeState::Downed begins (GameEvent::Downed); holds its last frame, then downed@loop (wraith look)
selene_death.purpose: the fatal blow: the head snaps back, the launcher sags, the knees buckle, she topples face down

selene_downed@loop.maps_to: LifeState::Downed (the Soul-Tether wraith; moves at 45 % speed with no gait, the client adds the ghost material)
selene_downed@loop.purpose: the wraith drift: slumped, floating 0.35 m off the ground, the launcher trailing from a limp hand, a slow bob

selene_revive.maps_to: an ally completes the Soul-Tether revive (Downed -> Alive)
selene_revive.purpose: pulled back into the body: a jolt with the arms flung wide, the feet slam down, crouch, rise into the hold

selene_reforge_in.maps_to: LifeState::Reforging ends: the hero reappears next to an ally
selene_reforge_in.purpose: forged anew: rises from a one-knee landing (the left claws on the ground), snaps the launcher up, takes the hold

selene_victory.maps_to: the run is won (GameEvent victory / boss down, results screen); holds its last frame
selene_victory.purpose: the storm answers: a crouch, then the launcher thrust to the sky, the left hand open wide; holds the pose

selene_ping.purpose: a ping: the left hand leaves the foregrip and points along the aim, open, the head follows

selene_interact.maps_to: the interact input at an anvil / forge / shrine POI (PoiState use); 1.3 s
selene_interact.purpose: work the anvil: lean over and press the left claws onto it (the launcher kept low in the right hand), straighten

selene_forge_hammer@loop.maps_to: the forge / hub anvil upgrade (Forge screen open, hub idle at the anvil)
selene_forge_hammer@loop.purpose: charging the anvil: the left palm raised, slammed down onto the work in a crackle, again

selene_idle_signature@loop.maps_to: standing out of combat for 6 s (then back to idle on any input)
selene_idle_signature@loop.purpose: lightning in human shape, barely touching the ground: a slow hover sway a hand's breadth up, the left claws flexing (the crackle; the vein pulse is an emissive VFX), the cloth breathing, the crown bobbing

selene_arc_nova.maps_to: active1 Arc Nova cast (chain-lightning burst); upper layer, so she keeps moving
selene_arc_nova.purpose: Arc Nova: gather (the left claws clenched at the chest), then both hands snap forward and apart, the claws spread, the launcher thrust out: the chain burst leaves her

selene_blink_out.maps_to: active2 Blink starts (the 7 m teleport through enemies); the client hides the model at 'vanish'
selene_blink_out.purpose: Blink, out: a crouch and a lean into the move; the model is hidden from the 'vanish' frame (storm trail VFX)

selene_blink_in.maps_to: active2 Blink ends (the model reappears at the target point)
selene_blink_in.purpose: Blink, in: she arrives leaning out of the jump, lands soft on the lead foot and settles into the hold

selene_heavens_verdict_start.maps_to: ultimate Heaven's Verdict cast (the storm front placed at the aim point)
selene_heavens_verdict_start.purpose: Heaven's Verdict, the call: gather low, sweep both arms up, head back, lifted off the ground as the storm front is called ('call'); ends on the verdict loop's frame 0

selene_heavens_verdict@loop.maps_to: while the Heaven's Verdict cast lasts (the client may cut back to locomotion when she moves)
selene_heavens_verdict@loop.purpose: Heaven's Verdict, sustained: hovering with both arms raised to the storm, a slow sway, the crown swaying wide round the head (the shard bones), the cloth lifted

selene_static_charge.maps_to: passive Static Charge reaches its cap (+60 %): played once in the upper layer
selene_static_charge.purpose: Static Charge full: the left hand leaves the foregrip and clenches in front of her chest, trembling, a crackle; back to the foregrip

playback.locomotion: playback rate = ground speed / clip_info.design_speed_mps (walk, run, strafe_*, backpedal)
playback.upper_layer: layer 'upper' clips: mask spine_01 and its children over locomotion; their first and last frames are selene_idle_combat@loop frame 0
playback.events: glTF has no events: clip_info.<clip>.events gives the frame and time of each (30 fps)
playback.weapon_variant: clip_info.<clip>.weapon_variant is null: thundercoil_launcher has no hand variants, so nothing swaps. The fist / open hand poses are the hero's own keyed fingers; clip_info.<clip>.hand_pose lists them per hand for reference
playback.in_place: only pelvis translates; the entity moves in the sim

weapon.attach: weapon scene = identity child of weapon_R; it has no offhand node. Two-handed: the right palm holds grip_R (the weapon root on weapon_R) and her clips key the left palm onto its grip_L (tools/blender/gf_hero/s4_selene.py apply_hold); a clip lets go where the pose says so (ping, Arc Nova, Static Charge, the dash and blink lunges, falls, carry and kit poses)

axes: glTF +Y up, 1 unit = 1 m. The hero faces +Z, origin on the ground between the feet, rest pose = T-pose. Socket nodes: -Z = forward (grip +Y), +Y = up, +X = right; a weapon scene attaches as an identity child.
